mapper.update: UPDATE community_posts SET title = #{title}, content = #{content}, category = #{category}, tags = #{tags}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE community_posts SET deleted_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE community_posts SET view_count = view_count + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT cp.id, cp.user_id as userId, u.name as author, cp.category, cp.title, cp.content, cp.view_count as viewCount, cp.comment_count as commentCount, cp.tags, DATE_FORMAT(cp.created_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as createdAt, DATE_FORMAT(cp.updated_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as updatedAt FROM community_posts cp LEFT JOIN users u ON cp.user_id = u.id WHERE cp.id = #{id} AND cp.deleted_at IS NULL
